title: On Removing the stone from the mouth of the drain
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：remove　|　正文 368 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 remove 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the keeper ① removed the stone from the mouth of the drain in silence, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② removes the stone from the mouth of the drain twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ remove the stone from the mouth of the drain at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ removed the stone from the mouth of the drain before — a line in the calendar for January 1984 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Removing the stone from the mouth of the drain in silence, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ remove his boots at the door twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Remove his boots at the door at once and never mention it again.

By 1997 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ removes his boots at the door in silence every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ removed the stone from the mouth of the drain again when nobody else would.

⑩ To remove the stone from the mouth of the drain, my mother said in 2002, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody removes the stone from the mouth of the drain twice over again and somebody must remove the stone from the mouth of the drain in silence all over again.

B. v. 移走（一般现在 removes the stone from the mouth of the drain：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 移走（不定式 to remove the stone from the mouth of the drain：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 移走（过去完成时 had removed the stone from the mouth of the drain：1984 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 移走（动名词 removing the stone from the mouth of the drain 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 remove 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the keeper removed the stone from the mouth of the drain in silence, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper removes the stone from the mouth of the drain twice over whenever the tower asks.
Removing the stone from the mouth of the drain in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever remove his boots at the door twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower removes his boots at the door in silence every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother removed the stone from the mouth of the drain again, and the tower remembered that half.
